Q1 FY27 Performance Highlights


  ➢  Revenue:
           - INR Revenue of ₹ 722,750 Mn, up 2.2% QoQ | up 13.9% YoY
           - USD Revenue of $ 7,624 Mn, Flat QoQ | up 2.7% YoY
           - Constant currency revenue up 0.4% QoQ | up 3.2% YoY

  ➢  Profit:
           - Operating Margin at 24.0%
           - Net Margin at 19.2%
           - Cash flow from operations at 93.0% of net profit

  ➢  Demand:

           -  Clients $10M+ up by 5 ; $5M+ up by 8 & $1M+ up by 4 QoQ

           -  Order book TCV at $9.5 Bn; North America TCV at $4.7 Bn; BFSI TCV at $2.5 Bn, Consumer Business TCV at $1.4 Bn

  ➢  People:
           - Closing headcount: 593,798
           - Voluntary LTM attrition at 13.6% in IT Services
